utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Nell, I think this Saturday is just for repair sign-ups—no need for folks to bring tools yet, unless I’ve managed to muddle that again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks Oren — I’d heard from Cleo that tools and supplies were needed, but maybe I mixed up the timing. I’ll hold off bringing anything Saturday unless someone confirms the collection spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds wise, Nell—Mara straightened me out that Saturday is sign-ups only, so I’ll check with her before telling anyone about tool drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Noah, I’m checking the repair drive supply list—do you know if you’re bringing anything, or if you’ve heard where folks are dropping items off?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m supposed to bring my toolbox, if I can track it down, and I heard Marta’s collecting tools by the laundry room for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Noah — I’ll mark your toolbox as tentative and note that Marta’s collecting by the laundry room Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus, we’re aiming for Saturday 9 to noon by the mailboxes and Uli’s potholes. If you can spare an hour, bring gloves or a rake.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Count me in, Leo—I’ll bring gloves, a rake, and my drill with clamps in case those porch rails or screen doors make the list too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. Main focus is the mailbox edge and potholes, but bring the drill just in case someone flags a quick rail or screen fix.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam, I’m helping Rosa line up intake volunteers and a few basic tool kits, and just so it’s clear, this Saturday is sign-ups only—no tool drop-off yet.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara—that helps. I’ll make sure folks hear Saturday is sign-ups only, and I’m still confirming the repair list and helper names so Mina can match people before daylight runs out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Sam—thank you. I’ll keep nudging intake volunteers and tool kit lenders, and I’ll make sure everyone hears that Mina needs the repair list and helper names early so she can match folks in time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Jules, before I commit, can you confirm who’s actually organizing the repair drive and exactly which repairs they’re covering?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have that confirmed yet, Kira—I’m still waiting on the final organizer details and repair categories, but I’ll check with Opal and make sure you get the specifics before anyone commits.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Jules. I’ll hold off until you’ve confirmed it with Opal, especially the organizer name and the exact repair categories.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Eli, have you heard anything solid about this repair drive folks are putting together? I’m itching to help spread the word, but I don’t want to send people chasing rumors.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Tess—we’re aiming for Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon, at the community room by the park, pending the room calendar. Tell folks small appliances, lamps, bikes, and basic clothing repairs are welcome; no fuel items, heavy furniture, or cracked screens.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s exactly the sort of solid detail I needed, Eli—thank you. I’ll spread it as “pending room confirmation” and make sure folks know what to bring and what to leave at home.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking on the exact time and place, but the main ask is clear: folks should sign up ahead and list what they’re bringing so the repair volunteers can prep.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That helps, Ira—I’ll keep my notes flexible until the time and place are set, but I’ll start tracking sign-ups by item type and where folks are coming from so volunteers can plan their tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Opal—tracking item type and where folks are coming from will really help. I’ll swing back once I’ve got a confirmed time and place.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Bo, we’re still aiming for Saturday morning by the laundry room—Marta’s gathering tools, and the worst spots are by the mailboxes and near my place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Uli — Saturday morning by the laundry room, got it. I’ll spread that around, and I’ll try to remember to check the thread about what Marta still needs for tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I appreciate you helping get the word out—every extra pair of hands will make it go faster.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Rey, we’re aiming for Saturday from 9 to noon for the repair drive, with bikes and small appliances first. I’m fitting the sign-up list around school pickup schedules—are you able to help during that window?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can come for the first hour or so and help sort the sign-up list quietly, Faye. I’d also heard about porch rails and screen doors—should I keep those notes separate from bikes and appliances?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please keep porch rails and screen doors on a separate notes list for now, Rey. The first hour would be a big help, especially with sorting the bike and small appliance sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, I’m trying to help spread the word about the repair drive, but Ira and Jules both said the time and drop-off details aren’t final yet. If you hear anything solid, will you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Vik — I’ll let you know as soon as the time and drop-off spot are confirmed. For now, you can tell folks we’re gathering repair needs and volunteers so we’re ready once the details are set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll tell folks we’re gathering repair needs and volunteers for now, and I’ll wait for the confirmed time and drop-off spot before spreading those details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam, I still need that confirmed list now—what items are on it, and which helpers have actually signed up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Mina, it’s Quinn — the accepted list is small appliances, lamps, bikes, and basic clothing repairs, with no fuel items, heavy furniture, or cracked screens. I’m still confirming the table layout and who’s handling sign-ups before I spread invitations or claim helpers are locked in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Quinn—send me the table layout and sign-up names as soon as you have them, and don’t announce helpers until we know who’s actually locked in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Dane, before we announce the repair drive, can we confirm the building manager approved the table area and name one person to handle sign-ups?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yes, let’s confirm the table area with the building manager first. I can handle sign-ups unless someone’s already been assigned.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, Dane—if you take sign-ups, I’ll wait on any announcements until we hear back from the manager about the table area.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Pia, I’m quietly checking which porch rails and screen doors are worst before the repair drive—have you heard of any that should go on the short list?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ve heard Mrs. Alvarez’s screen door sticks badly, but before we add too many names, do we know where the repair tables will be set and who’s tracking the list?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good point—I don’t know that yet, so I’ll ask who’s keeping the master list before I spread names around. I’ll make a note about Mrs. Alvarez’s door for now and check where the tables are being set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Kira—I'm setting the request list and name tags on the folding table by the community room door, and I’ll keep the spare bits and clamps in the crate underneath.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Gus, but has the building manager confirmed that spot by the community room door? And can you remind me who’s officially organizing the drive before we put names down?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good catch, Kira—I’ll double-check with the building manager before we set up there. As far as I know, the neighborhood committee is organizing it, and I’m just helping wrangle tools and stations.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Jules, have you heard anything solid about the repair drive yet? Rey’s checking quietly too, but I’m ready to help spread the word once we know what they need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t heard a firm date or drop-off plan yet, but I’m keeping a list of helpers by block and who can haul tools. Once Opal or Rey pins down the details, I’ll loop you and Vik in for spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Jules—put me down for spreading the word, and I can check who on my block might have tools to lend once Opal or Rey confirms what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Vik, I’m interested in helping, but I’m waiting on Faye’s confirmed list this afternoon so I don’t pass along guesses about what’s covered or who’s already signed up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That makes sense, Hana—once Faye’s list is confirmed this afternoon, send me what’s solid and I’ll help pass it along without adding any guesses.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik—I’ll forward only the confirmed repair priorities, organizer details, and signup gaps once Faye sends them, and I’ll mark anything unclear as pending.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, have you heard from Sam yet, or do we still need to chase down the repair list and volunteer names ourselves?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet—I’m still out running errands, but I’m going to ask around today and try to pin down the repair list, volunteer names, and the time and place before we start chasing everyone separately.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please text me the moment you get anything solid, especially the names and which bikes or appliances are on the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Dane—sorry, I’m a little scattered, but I think the repair drive’s still Saturday morning by the laundry room, and we’re starting with the wobbly porch steps. Does that match what you heard?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly, yeah—Gus had me on check-ins and matching folks to stations, and Eli was checking the community room for drop-off, so I’ll confirm whether we’re using the laundry room or community room before we tell people. Porch steps first sounds sensible if that’s the urgent repair.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane—that’s exactly the bit I’d probably muddle, so I’ll hold off saying a location until you confirm. I’ll still plan to bring my toolbox for the porch steps Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Quinn, we’re aiming for Saturday morning from 9 to noon for the repair drive, with bikes and small appliances first on the list. I’m coordinating around school pickup schedules and will have the sign-up list sorted this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Faye — I’ll hold off on blasting invites until you confirm the sign-up list this afternoon, then I can spread the word with Saturday 9 to noon, bikes and small appliances up front.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn, that would be perfect. I’ll send you the confirmed sign-up list this afternoon so your invite has the right details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Uli—just so we’re aligned, this Saturday is sign-ups for repairs only, not tool drop-off. I’m already asking around for intake volunteers and basic tool kits, and I’d love your help spreading the word accurately.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh—thank you, Mara, I had that wrong. I’ll tell Leo and Noah it’s sign-ups only this Saturday, and that tools come later once you’ve sorted the kits.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Uli—that helps a lot. Please ask Leo and Noah if either of them can also do a short intake shift, and I’ll keep the tool-kit list coordinated with Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Sam. I’d like to keep this repair drive simple: Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon, at the community room by the park, with a clear list of accepted items.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Morning, Eli — that sounds good to me, and I’ll keep the accepted-items list tight. I’m confirming the current repairs and volunteer signups today, then I can share a clean list for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Please send me that clean list by this evening, and I’ll make sure it matches the notice before Quinn starts spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Leo, I’ve only heard second-hand that the repair drive still needs basics like duct tape, batteries, gloves, and hand tools. Do you know where they’re collecting everything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I haven’t heard a collection spot yet. I’ll ask Uli, but Saturday 9 to noon by the mailboxes is the repair window I know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Leo — that helps. I’ll hold onto the duct tape and batteries for now, and if you hear back from Uli about the drop-off spot, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Opal, once you have a few names and items noted, could you send them my way? I’ll fold them into the sign-up sheet so we can match volunteers and tools more easily.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, Rosa—I’ll send you the first batch once I’ve got names, items, and locations checked, so your sheet stays tidy. I’ll flag anything needing transport or special tools too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Opal—thank you. If you can mark the transport or special-tool needs clearly, I’ll make sure we pair those with the right volunteers early.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Bo, I think this Saturday is just for signing folks up, not bringing tools—Mara set me straight on that. And when repairs actually start, those wobbly porch steps are probably first on my list, unless I’m forgetting something.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ah, thanks Oren—I’d skimmed it wrong then. I’ll tell folks Saturday is just signup, and porch steps sound like a good one to list when repairs start.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s perfect, Bo—thank you. If you see me wandering around with a hammer Saturday, just send me home with a reminder it’s sign-ups only.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
